findings.current: Im Changsoo, who had just been about to send his men forward, shut his mouth and listened.
findings.defect: The draft reverses Changsoo’s intended order: he was about to pull his men back, not send them forward.
findings.rationale: 물리려던 means he intended to make his subordinates withdraw, so “send his men forward” changes the action.
findings.replacement: Im Changsoo, who had just been about to call his men back, closed his mouth and listened.
findings.source: 안 그래도 막 부하들을 물리려던 임창수가 입을 다물며 귀를 기울였다.

findings.current: A common C-rank Hunter. He wasn’t even part of a major Guild, and he was nothing more than a mayfly scraping by on high-end equipment he had no business owning. Yet his attitude and way of speaking were strangely confident.
findings.defect: The draft changes leased equipment into equipment Taekyung owns and uses the unnatural literal calque “mayfly.”
findings.rationale: 리스 해서 explicitly says the equipment is leased, while 하루살이 characterizes him as an insignificant, precarious small-timer rather than literally as a mayfly.
findings.replacement: A run-of-the-mill C-rank Hunter. He wasn’t even part of a major Guild, just a small-timer scraping by with high-end equipment he’d leased despite it being above his station. Yet his attitude and way of speaking were strangely confident.
findings.source: 흔해 빠진 C급 헌터. 대형 길드 소속도 아니고, 주제에 안 맞는 고급 장비를 리스 해서 연명하는 하루살이에 불과한데 태도나 말투는 묘하게 당당하다.

findings.current: “If I lose this bet, that’s what will happen, right?”
findings.defect: The draft makes Song Song personally responsible for losing the contest, although the condition concerns Taekyung and the Peace Guild’s side losing.
findings.rationale: Song Song is the stake in the wager rather than the person fighting the Minotaurs; the context supplies the Peace Guild side as the omitted subject.
findings.replacement: “If we lose this bet, that’s what will happen, right?”

findings.defect: The declarative translation drops the tentative, question-like delivery of the Korean.
findings.rationale: 아마 and the ending -지 않을까요 jointly convey probability and a cautiously solicited judgment.
findings.replacement: “It would probably be difficult, wouldn’t it?”

findings.current: “Okay. I’ll be blunt. You’re not my type.”
findings.defect: The draft omits both the baseball metaphor emphasizing Song Song’s blunt rejection and Changsoo’s visible reaction.
findings.rationale: The omitted narration preserves the exact quantity, extends the 돌직구 joke, and shows that the rejection unsettles Changsoo.
findings.replacement:
“Okay. I’ll be blunt. You’re not my type.”

Her blunt declaration came in like a 160-kilometer-per-hour fastball, tight and inside. Im Changsoo’s gaze wavered.
findings.source:
“음. 단도직입적으로 말할게요. 그쪽, 내 취향 아니에요.”

시속 160km. 몸 쪽 꽉 찬 돌직구에 임창수의 눈빛이 흔들렸다.

findings.current: You don’t seem interested in anything except getting into bed with me. Isn’t that right?
findings.defect: The draft replaces the source’s crude but comic euphemism with a more explicit statement.
findings.rationale: 배꼽 맞추다 literally evokes putting their belly buttons together; “bumping bellies” retains the sexual implication, comic imagery, and euphemistic register.
findings.replacement: You don’t seem interested in anything but bumping bellies with me. Am I right?
findings.source: 그쪽은 나랑 배꼽 맞추는 것밖에 관심 없어 보이는데. 맞죠?

findings.current: She kept smoothing her hair and speaking one line at a time, but every blow landed like a nuclear bomb.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Song Song appears bashful while delivering her devastating remarks, weakening the characterization and comic contrast.
findings.rationale: 수줍은 듯이 is an explicit pragmatic cue whose contrast with her blunt comments creates the humor.
findings.replacement: As if bashful, she toyed with her hair while delivering one line after another, each blow landing like a nuclear bomb.
findings.source: 수줍은 듯이 머리를 매만지며 한마디씩 하는데, 한 방 한 방이 거의 핵폭탄 급이다.

findings.current: “All Earthlings are crazy by nature. Ever heard of geocentrism? You ignorant bastard.”
findings.defect: The draft preserves only the insanity sense of 돌다 and loses the shift to physical rotation that prompts Team Leader Choi’s astronomical correction.
findings.rationale: 돌았냐 and 돌고 있어 pivot from being insane to rotating; the rotation meaning is necessary for the ensuing heliocentrism-versus-geocentrism joke.
findings.replacement: “Everyone on Earth is already spinning. Don’t you know geocentrism, you ignorant bastard?”
findings.source: “원래 지구인들은 다 돌고 있어. 천동설도 모르냐? 이 무식한 새끼.”

findings.current: With the two irritating bastards, Jang Taekyung and Choi Minwoo, standing together, it was only natural that Im Changsoo’s eyes and ears hadn’t left them.
findings.defect: “His eyes and ears hadn’t left them” is an unnatural English calque.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally conveys that Changsoo continued watching and listening to the pair without changing the action.
findings.replacement: With the two irritating bastards, Jang Taekyung and Choi Minwoo, standing together, it was only natural for Im Changsoo to keep his eyes and ears trained on them.
findings.source: 장태경, 최민우. 거슬리는 두 놈이 붙어 있으니 임창수의 눈과 귀가 그쪽에서 떨어지지 않았던 것도 당연했다.

findings.current: At the first abuse like that he had ever heard, Im Changsoo’s brain froze.
findings.defect: “At the first abuse like that he had ever heard” is unidiomatic and obscures that he had never received such an insult in his life.
findings.rationale: 난생처음 emphasizes a lifetime first, while 폭언 here refers to Taekyung’s verbal abuse or insult.
findings.replacement: Im Changsoo’s brain froze at an insult unlike anything he had ever heard in his life.
findings.source: 난생처음 들어 보는 폭언에 임창수의 뇌가 정지했다.

findings.defect: The response is stiff and unnaturally imperative in English.
findings.rationale: 그러시죠 is Choi’s calm assent to Song Song changing Guilds under the stated condition, naturally expressed here as permission.

findings.current:
Where did this confidence come from?

Faith in himself? Or faith in the version of me he had watched until now?
findings.defect: “The version of me he had watched” is awkward and adds the notion of a distinct version of Taekyung absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 그동안 지켜본 내 모습 refers simply to what Choi has observed of Taekyung up to this point.
findings.replacement:
Where did this confidence come from?

Faith in himself? Or in what he’d seen of me so far?
findings.source: 이 자신감의 근원이 어딜까? 자기 자신에 대한 믿음? 아니면 그동안 지켜본 내 모습?

summary: One reversed action and several meaningful omissions or alterations affect scene logic, characterization, humor, and register; additional localized wording needs correction for natural English.
